text: A small ball of energy swelling into being: a soft, rounded, slightly fizzing bloom with a warm glow. Not a click, not a tick. No bell, no chime, no voices, no music.
A little orb of magical energy gently swelling up out of nothing: a warm, round, fizzing puff of light that grows and settles. Not a click, not a tick. No bell, no chime, no voices, no music.
